pcb.basis: Published planar dimensions only. Rendered thickness is unmeasured and cannot establish physical fit.

mountingHoles.basis: Published R1.0, 1.8 mm edge offsets and 21.8 mm transverse center distance; these are nominal drawing values.

headerFootprints.basis: 22 positions per row and 2.54 mm pitch. Longitudinal start from dimension drawing 5.05 mm; transverse centers and drill diameter are photo estimates.

endNotch.basis: Visible U-shaped end opening, estimated against the nominal PCB extent. Notch is open in the model; no dimensional tolerance is claimed.

header.basis: Exact-SKU photograph shows two rows of 22 soldered pins. Planar count/pitch follow the nominal family dimension drawing; no native header component is claimed.

module.basis: The exact option is a distinct electrical product. Its envelope is a manual photo approximation, not a copied N8R8 native component.

limitations: Newly generated model with new hashes and new validation. Historical batch-04 reviews are not acceptance of these artifacts.
No physical fit, material calibration, complete hidden layout, original application compatibility or hardware acceptance is implied.
USB shell is physically open in the mesh but contact tongues, detailed contacts and mating dimensions remain unknown. Source-photo parallax does not measure connector height.

Exact 1U module, RF connector and notch CAD was not found in inspected official sources. Coax and external antenna remain visible source references only; their length, curvature and attachment geometry are not invented.
Header count/centers are source-backed; body and pin dimensions including hidden insertion length remain unmeasured estimates. No physical mating guarantee.
Only N8R8 has inspected original native STEP. No N8R8 internal electrical package geometry or exact module shield dimensions are transferred to this SKU.
Front small passives, silkscreen, concealed components, reverse placement and stackup remain UNKNOWN. The model retains visible large component envelopes and the actual board openings only.
Nominal family board dimensions are supported by the official family drawing; exact-option planar congruence is checked by manual photo registration, not by metrology.

exactVariant.basis: Four manually selected exact-photo mounting-hole centers are paired with the independent dimension drawing: X = ±10.9 mm, Y = ±29.85 mm. Source hashes match the retained exact option; old model acceptance is not reused.
